seo_about_body: Dofus Forge is a free online build planner for Dofus 3. Equip items from the complete catalog, track set bonuses in real time, simulate Magesmithy (Forgemagie) runes, and let the stat optimizer find the best gear combination for your character — no account or installation needed.
seo_feature_catalog_desc: Browse every Dofus 3 item by slot, level, element and set, with real in-game icons and stats.
seo_feature_sets_desc: See active set bonuses update live as you equip pieces from the same Dofus set.
seo_feature_runes_desc: Simulate Forgemagie rune slots and their stat bonuses before spending resources in-game.
seo_feature_optimizer_desc: The Forger auto-generates the best equipment combination for your target stats and constraints.
seo_feature_share_desc: Every build gets a unique URL — share your setup instantly, no login required.
seo_feature_explore_desc: Browse, bookmark and rate builds published by other players.
seo_how_2: Equip items slot by slot from the catalog.
seo_how_3: Watch your stats and set bonuses update in real time.
seo_how_4: Share your build link or publish it to Explore.
seo_faq_a1: Yes, it's completely free and no account is required to build or share.
seo_faq_q2: Does it support all Dofus classes?
seo_faq_a2: Yes, every current Dofus 3 class is supported with its spells and characteristics.
seo_faq_q3: Is the item data up to date?
seo_faq_a3: Yes, item and set data is kept in sync with the current Dofus 3 game version.
seo_faq_q4: Can I share my build with others?
seo_faq_a4: Yes, every build generates a unique shareable URL instantly.
seo_faq_q5: Is Dofus Forge available in my language?
seo_faq_a5: Dofus Forge is available in English, Spanish, French and Portuguese.
explore_seo_description: Browse Dofus 3 builds shared by the community — filter by class, sort by rating, likes or views, and find inspiration for your own setup.
build_detail_seo_description: Dofus 3 {{class}} build at level {{level}} — view equipment, stats and set bonuses, shared on Dofus Forge.
seo_classes_body: Build for any class — Iop, Cra, Eniripsa, Sram, Sacrier, Sadida and every other Dofus 3 class, each with its own spells, characteristics and best-in-slot gear.
about_seo_description: Dofus Forge is a free, fan-made build planner for Dofus 3. Learn why it exists, where its data comes from, and who makes it.
about_intro: Dofus Forge is a free, fan-made build planner for Dofus 3 — a tool built by a player, for players, to make planning gear and stats less tedious than testing everything live in-game.
about_why_body: Testing gear combinations in Dofus costs kamas, forgemagie dust and time. Dofus Forge lets you try any item, any set, any rune combination instantly, see the resulting stats and set bonuses right away, and only commit once you like the numbers.
about_data_body: Item, set and spell data comes from the DofusDude API and is kept in sync with the current Dofus 3 game version shown in the header. Nothing is hand-entered or guessed.
about_free_body: Building and sharing a setup is free and doesn't require an account. Signing in is optional — it unlocks saving builds to the cloud, publishing them to Explore, and liking, rating or commenting on other players' builds.
about_team_body: Built and maintained by Juan (Wembie). Game data and testing happen on the Tal Kasha server, with in-game support from Raik-Luck.
howto_seo_description: A step-by-step guide to planning a Dofus 3 build — picking a class, equipping items, reading stats and set bonuses, forgemagie runes, the stat optimizer, and sharing your build.
howto_intro: No sign-up needed to start — open the planner and follow along. Here's every step, in order.
howto_step1_body: Choose your class from the Class panel and set your level — characteristic points to allocate update automatically based on it.
howto_step2_body: Click any empty slot in the Equipment grid to open the catalog. Filter by level, element, set or stat, then click an item to equip it.
howto_step3_body: The Stats panel recalculates live as you equip gear or allocate points. Active Set Bonuses appear automatically once you have 2 or more pieces from the same set.
howto_step4_body: Click an equipped item to add runes and simulate their stat bonuses before spending real resources in-game.
howto_step5_title: 5. Let the optimizer find the best gear
howto_step5_body: "The Forger" auto-generates the best equipment combination for a stat you target, given your constraints — open it from the header.
howto_step6_body: Toggle Compare to see your current build side by side against another one, stat by stat.
howto_step7_body: Share copies a link to your exact setup instantly, no account needed. Sign in to Publish it to Explore so other players can find, rate and comment on it.
howto_step8_body: My Builds lists everything you've saved, with visibility controls — private, unlisted, or public.

privacy_seo_description: How Dofus Forge collects, uses, and protects your data, including cookies and Google AdSense advertising.
privacy_intro: Dofus Forge ("we", "us") is a free, fan-made build planner for Dofus 3. This page explains what information we collect when you use the site, how it's used, and the choices you have.
privacy_s1_body: If you create an account, we collect your email address, username, and any display name, avatar, or bio you choose to add — handled through our authentication provider, Supabase. The builds, comments, likes, ratings, and follows you create are stored so the site can show them to you and, where you choose to make them public, to other users. We do not sell your personal data to anyone.
privacy_s2_body: We use cookies and browser local storage to keep you signed in, remember your language preference, and store draft builds in progress. These are functional and are not used to track you across other websites.
privacy_s3_body: We show ads through Google AdSense to help cover hosting costs. Google and its partners may use cookies and similar technologies to serve ads based on your visits to this and other sites. Where required (for example, in the EEA and UK), we ask for your consent before showing personalized ads. You can review or change your ad preferences at Google's Ad Settings (adssettings.google.com), and learn more in Google's own Privacy Policy.
privacy_s4_body: You can access, correct, export, or delete your account and its data at any time from your Account page, or by emailing us. If you're in the EEA, UK, or another region with data protection laws (such as the GDPR or CCPA), you also have the right to object to or restrict certain processing of your data.
privacy_s5_body: We keep your account data for as long as your account exists. Deleting your account removes your profile and private builds; builds you made public may be anonymized rather than deleted outright if other users have interacted with them (likes, comments), to keep those discussions coherent.
privacy_s6_body: Dofus Forge is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.
privacy_s7_body: We may update this page as the site evolves. Meaningful changes will be reflected in the "Last updated" date above.
privacy_contact: Questions about this policy? Email us at contact@dofusforge.com.
terms_seo_description: The terms that govern your use of Dofus Forge, including accounts, user content, and acceptable use.
terms_intro: These Terms govern your use of Dofus Forge. By using the site, you agree to them.
terms_s1_body: By accessing or using Dofus Forge, you agree to these Terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.
terms_s2_body: Dofus Forge is a free tool for planning, saving, and sharing Dofus 3 character builds. Game data (items, sets, spells) is sourced from public game files and kept up to date as the game changes; we can't guarantee it's always perfectly accurate — always double-check important decisions in-game.
terms_s3_body: You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for anything that happens under your account. Don't create an account with false information or impersonate someone else.
terms_s4_body: You keep ownership of the builds, comments, and other content you post. By making something public or unlisted, you allow other users (and, for public content, search engines and anyone with the link) to view it. Don't post content that's illegal, hateful, infringing, or spam.
terms_s5_body: Don't abuse, scrape, or attempt to disrupt the site. We may remove content or suspend accounts that violate these Terms or that other users report to us. You can report a comment or build by emailing contact@dofusforge.com with a link to it.
terms_s6_body: The Dofus Forge name, design, and code belong to its creator. Dofus and related names, items, and assets are trademarks and copyrighted material of their respective owner; they are referenced here only to describe the game this tool is for.
terms_s7_body: Dofus Forge is provided "as is", with no warranty of any kind. We do our best to keep data accurate and the site running, but we are not liable for any loss or damage resulting from using it, including decisions made based on the optimizer's suggestions.
terms_s8_body: We may update these Terms, suspend the service, or close accounts that violate them, at any time. These Terms are governed by the laws applicable to your place of residence, to the extent permitted by law.
terms_contact: Questions about these Terms? Email us at contact@dofusforge.com.

optimizer_activate_hint: Click to add this stat to the order with a suggested purity
optimizer_points_auto: The Forger spends the characteristic points for each piece.
optimizer_banned_empty: none — ban items from a result
optimizer_ban_item: Exclude this item from the next forging
optimizer_order_help: Place your order. Minimum (≥): what the piece must have. Purity ⚖: what each point of that stat is worth (missing points cost it, surplus earns it). Cap (≤): how far it counts; locked, anything above it is discarded. The Forger first meets every minimum, then fills the highest-purity stats. Power counts toward Strength, Intelligence, Chance and Agility.
optimizer_cap_soft_hint: Soft cap: anything above it stops counting but does not discard the piece. Click the lock to make it strict. Empty = no cap.
optimizer_cap_strict_hint: Strict cap: any piece above it is discarded. Click the lock to make it soft.
optimizer_intensity_quick_hint: 15 to 45 s with up to 4 threads. Good for trying ideas.
optimizer_intensity_standard_hint: 45 s to 3 min using half your CPU (at least 4 threads); tempers itself once the piece stops improving. Recommended.
optimizer_intensity_master_hint: 2 to 8 min using your whole CPU, for very demanding orders.
optimizer_transcendence_hint: Adds one official transcendence rune (Tra/Pa/Ra) per forgeable item, sized by the line the item already has.
optimizer_heat_hint: The forge cools while no better piece appears; once cold, The Forger tempers the result.
optimizer_stage_melting: Melting the metal: some minimums are still missing
optimizer_unmet_advice: The best piece meets {{met}} of {{total}} minimums. Try the Master forge, lower a minimum or unlock more slots.
optimizer_quality_hint: Negative: what is missing from the minimums. Positive: all met, higher the more you get of what matters.
optimizer_ley_hint: Purity: exact value of each point of this stat. Points missing from the minimum cost their purity; surplus points earn it, up to the cap.
optimizer_unpursued_hint: With purity 0 this minimum does not count: The Forger will not chase it.
optimizer_scale_hint: What one point of each stat is worth next to the lightest one, by their purity.
optimizer_intensity_eternal_hint: The forge never goes out on its own: it keeps searching until you temper it.
optimizer_heat_eternal_hint: Eternal fire: the heat shows how long since a better piece appeared. Stoke the fire if it cools.
optimizer_bellows_hint: The bellows melts fresh metal to break out of a stuck shape, without losing the best piece.
optimizer_strikes_hint: Hammer strikes: pieces tried on the anvil
optimizer_log_relit: 🔥 The forge is relit with the previous pieces
optimizer_log_first: ⚒ First piece on the anvil · quality {{q}}
optimizer_reforge_hint: Relights the forge starting from these pieces: the result never gets worse.
optimizer_plateau_hint: The piece looks finished: it has not improved noticeably for a while. Temper it now, or stoke the fire to search elsewhere.
optimizer_surplus_hint: What the piece has beyond each minimum and what it is worth in purity. That is your margin: raise those minimums or ask for more stats.
